caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or woven coverlet with a complex, symmetrical pattern consisting of various geometric and floral motifs. The main colors used are red, dark blue, light green, and white. The textile is sectioned into horizontal bands, alternating between red backgrounds with intricate white and green floral designs, and blue backgrounds with white geometric and leaf-like elements. The left edge features a wide vertical border with alternating boxes of floral and geometric patterns in red, green, blue, and white. Towards the bottom left corner, a green box contains the white text "DAVID STAUCH 1846 REBECCA MELLER.” The textile is fringed on three sides: the left side fringe is in red, green, and blue; the bottom fringe is light beige, and the top and right edges are cut straight. The overall appearance is tightly composed, with repeating motifs filling the space, and the drawing is set against a plain beige background.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
